title: POST /sensors/location returns 4.05, vector consumer expects 4.04
description: Pre-existing failure found during qpux verification (not caused by qpux work; qpux agent ran the suite unchanged). python/tests/coap/test_lci_auth.py:286 - LCI observable /sensors/location returns 4.05 Method Not Allowed for POST while the test/vector expects 4.04 Not Found. Determine the correct semantics (observable resources vs method dispatch order in the LCI CoAP server) and make the vector-driven test pass without weakening it. File: python/tests/coap/test_lci_auth.py:286.
close_reason: Does not reproduce on HEAD; semantics verified correct and pinned. (1) The described failure (POST /sensors/location -> 4.05) cannot occur: aiocoap Site.render raises NotFound at path lookup BEFORE method dispatch, so an unregistered path returns 4.04 for every verb - empirically confirmed GET/POST/PUT/DELETE all -> 4.04. (2) The cited test_lci_auth.py:286 was inside test_messages_alias_loopback_succeeds at filing time; TestSensorsLocationAuth has been GET-based and passing since introduction (eb65707987, 2026-07-24) - bead was a misattributed qpux report. (3) Hardened the test to iterate GET/POST/PUT/DELETE all expecting 4.04 (any future handler wiring or 4.05 regression now fails the test); 29/29 pass, ruff clean. Reviewer 3x: correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases PASS with one P3 diagnosability finding -> filed project-LICHEN-worker6-d9pl. Side observation: 2 pre-existing edhoc_responder flaky failures confirmed and commented on existing bead up5p.
